flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui utils/Meta/System.ts and utils/models/Fsystemadmin.d.ts (only a 'Court Installment Plans' menu label, no page), pages/System/list (5 other pages), i18n 'court_fine_installment'; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase (3 columns). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no instalment
note: Requirement status is not given in stories.json (blank); the story is traced normally. The story asks staff to record/amend court fine instalment plans (month, monthly amount). The code has no such feature. The UI only has the entry 'Court Installment Plans' in Meta/System.ts:159-162 and the type COURT_INSTALLMENT_PLANS in Fsystemadmin.d.ts:29, with no list or form component (pages/System/list only has Parameter, RuleCode, SchedulePublicHoliday, StandardCode, SuspensionReason) and no backend; ocms_court_case only has notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason. Synonyms grepped across six repos: installment, instalment, instalment plan, monthly amount, cicilan: zero hits in the backend. No maintenance ticket mentions instalment (CSV grep). court_payment_due_date is used by the Payment Acceptance Cutoff cron, but it is a single date, not a monthly plan; not credited.
recommendation: Do not claim as complete. Ask URA/the team where recording court fine instalment plans is built, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: The officer opens the court fine instalment plan screen
steps.detail: There is only a menu entry 'Court Installment Plans' with a system path (Meta/System.ts:159-162) and the type name COURT_INSTALLMENT_PLANS (Fsystemadmin.d.ts:29). There is no list/form component and the type is not used in pages/System, so no screen can be opened. Synonyms: installment, instalment, plan.

steps.step: The officer enters the month and the monthly amount payable
steps.detail: There is no month or monthly amount field for instalments in the UI (grep installment only hits Meta/System.ts and Fsystemadmin.d.ts) and no DTO or column in the backend.

steps.step: OCMS saves or amends the instalment plan
steps.detail: There is no instalment entity, repository, controller or cron in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi. The only per-notice court data is court_payment_due_date and reason (OcmsCourtCase.java:24-31), and no controller writes it; it is only read through plus-get-court-case-info and the cutoff cron.

steps.step: The instalment details are correctly updated and visible on the notice
steps.detail: There is no instalment display on the notice; the court tab in History.tsx:170-172 is commented out and its grid (History.tsx:71-100) only has Court Outcome/Status with no instalment. The i18n label 'court_fine_installment' (i18n/en/translation.json:121) is not used by any component (ts/tsx grep returns nothing).
